title: SeedFlood: A Step Toward Scalable Decentralized Fine-Tuning of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2602.18181v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This work presents SeedFlood, a new approach to decentralized LLM fine-tuning designed to scale across large models, large collaborations, and complex network topologies while achieving global consensus with negligible communication overhead. Traditional methods suffer from high communication costs that grow with model size, while information decay over network hops renders global consensus inefficient. SeedFlood takes a significant departure from these practices by exploiting the seed-reconstructible structure of zeroth-order gradients and effectively making the messages to transmit near-zero in size, allowing them to be flooded to every client in the network, and thereby enhancing scalability of decentralized training. Consequently, SeedFlood enables training in regimes previously considered impractical, such as billion-parameter scale models or distributed across hundred of clients. Our experiments on decentralized LLM fine-tuning

translated_title: SeedFlood：迈向可扩展的去中心化大语言模型微调的一步
translated_abstract: 本工作提出了SeedFlood，一种新的去中心化大语言模型微调方法，旨在跨大型模型、大规模协作和复杂网络拓扑进行扩展，同时以可忽略不计的通信开销实现全局共识。传统方法受到随模型规模增长的高通信成本的困扰，而信息在网络跳数间的衰减也使全局共识效率低下。SeedFlood与这些现有做法有重大区别：它利用零阶梯度的种子可重构结构，有效地将传输的消息大小缩减至接近于零，从而可以将消息洪泛到网络中的每个客户端，进而提升去中心化训练的可扩展性。因此，SeedFlood使得在以前被认为不切实际的场景中进行训练成为可能，例如十亿参数规模的模型或分布于数百个客户端的训练。我们在去中心化LLM微调上的实验……
tldr: SeedFlood通过利用零阶梯度可由随机种子重构的特性，将通信消息压缩至近乎零大小并洪泛至网络中所有客户端，从而以极低的通信开销实现了可扩展的去中心化大语言模型微调。
en_tdlr: SeedFlood exploits the seed-reconstructible structure of zeroth-order gradients to shrink transmitted messages to near-zero size and flood them to every client, enabling scalable decentralized LLM fine-tuning with negligible communication overhead.
